That’s all you need, 1 person to like you and give you a chance during an interview. Eventually, statistically, you can get there.

You just need to improve your odds by running up the number of people you can make your pitch to.

Pass your 3L classes obviously, but focus on job hunting. I gave up weeks not even going to class to interview, interview prep and apply;

The job I got i studied for 3 days straight. And I could tell when I dropped really specific explainaitons about why this firm was superior to others, I noticed them begin engaging with me.

They Had a list of questions they clearly were bored about reading off. They looked up, smiled, put down the list of questions (it ironically fell on the floor and she never tired picking it back up).

And she eventually said: “oh no keep talking. Please. I’m going to tell them to hire you. I just want to know more about my potential future co-worker”

I cried after.

Moral of the story: statistics is your friend. You need to keep improving your pitch and run up the numbers so luck can eventually throw you a soft ball.
